notes.title: The Hotel | Version 1.1.4
notes.content: [h1]Changelog[/h1][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]The song 'Never-Ending' has been updated to sound similar to what was heard in the Steam Release trailer.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugs[/h2][list][*][p]When arriving on a new floor via the elevator, the doors wouldn't open. This was more common when arriving on checkpoint floors or floor 249. The script has been rewritten to now open the doors if the player is inside the elevator and close if they are not, rather than being controlled through events.[/p][/*][*][p]Floor 250 effects were broken for some reason. It rotated away from the camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Saving and loading on floor 250 would generate random floors instead of showing the top floor.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Hotel | Version 1.1.3 Patch
notes.content: [h1]Changelog[/h1][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Candlestick flames now use a custom wobble shader. Animates pretty nicely.[/p][/*][*][p]Candlesticks now only use one light, less are found on tables also.[/p][/*][*][p]Mat&Pull model has been made into one object instead of being multiple cubes.[/p][/*][*][p]Sun intensity fades as time moves on during sunset, should help avoid the sun from leaking through the walls.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugs[/h2][list][*][p]Jabberwock animation has been fixed. There were extra keyframes that preventing the animation from looping correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Showing the UI after hiding it would bug out the floor flip animation. It'll fade in and out like normal, when entering a new floor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fancy light had incorrect shadows and created a weird square against the wall.[/p][/*][*][p]Plant pot was blocking a door in the House biome.[/p][/*][/list]
